Name: AstroDomeBlueStar
Notes:
A unique pull star used to transition to the AstroDome stage selector. Utilises the same effect data as the regular GCaptureTarget.

Plays sound effect SE_SY_GCAPTURE_APPEAR on load and SE_OJ_LV_MAGIC_PNT_G_POINT when player is within a certain distance. Plays SE_OJ_MAGIC_PNT_G_ON when the cursor hovers over it.

DemoCast.Description: Can take part in a cutscene.

DemoSimpleCast.Description: Continues movement during cutscenes, NPC conversations, etc.
